modules.title: Data and probability
modules.synopsis: This module moves from linguistic records to probability spaces, events, probability measures, conditional probability, Bayes' rule, and independence.

modules.title: Random variables and distributions
modules.synopsis: This module introduces random variables, discrete and continuous distributions, expectations, variation, simulation, and joint distributions.

modules.title: Statistical inference
modules.synopsis: This module develops frequentist and Bayesian approaches to learning about a population from a sample, including uncertainty and posterior computation.

modules.title: Linear regression
modules.synopsis: This module builds linear regression from conditional means through multiple predictors, interactions, uncertainty, residuals, and model checks.

modules.title: Model criticism and prediction
modules.synopsis: This module asks what a model predicts for observations it did not see and develops loss functions, cross-validation, and predictive comparison.

modules.title: Generalized linear models
modules.synopsis: This module extends regression to binary, ordinal, count, and bounded linguistic responses using standard generalized linear models.

modules.title: Experimental design
modules.synopsis: This module connects units of assignment, randomization, within-participant and between-participant designs, counterbalancing, exclusions, and power.

modules.title: Mixed effects models
modules.synopsis: This module represents repeated speakers, items, verbs, and other groups with random intercepts, random slopes, and mixed effects models.

modules.title: Latent structure
modules.synopsis: This module develops clustering and finite mixture models for recurring groups that are not supplied as response labels.

modules.title: Factorization
modules.synopsis: This module introduces low rank matrix structure, singular value decomposition, principal component analysis, reconstruction, and component choice.

modules.title: Missing data
modules.synopsis: This module distinguishes missingness patterns from missingness mechanisms, then evaluates complete case analysis and imputation.

modules.title: Custom model design
modules.synopsis: This module turns annotation protocols and linguistic measurement claims into joint probability models and checks whether their parameters can be recovered.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.synopsis: This page explains how the five problem sets function as assigned readings and links each problem set when it becomes available.

assignments.title: PS1: Paired acoustic measurements
assignments.synopsis: This problem set uses Hillenbrand vowel measurements to develop inference for paired acoustic measurements and speaker-level resampling.

assignments.title: PS2: Prediction across passages
assignments.synopsis: This problem set uses Provo Corpus eye movements to compare passage-level predictions under grouped cross-validation.

assignments.title: PS3: Dative alternation and logistic regression
assignments.synopsis: This problem set uses English dative alternation data to develop logistic regression and evaluation on verbs omitted during fitting.

assignments.title: PS4: Commitment in discourse
assignments.synopsis: This problem set uses CommitmentBank judgments to develop ordinal mixed models, model checks, and discourse-grouped validation.

assignments.title: PS5: Structure in phoneme inventories
assignments.synopsis: This problem set uses PHOIBLE inventories to develop singular value decomposition and held-out reconstruction.
